titulo: Qualcomm’s Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 comes in an Extreme version too
cuerpo: Qualcomm has announced the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6, this year joined by the 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 too. The company describes both new phone chips as flagships, and the spec differences are relatively minor, mostly limited to improved AI processing, video capture, and gaming performance on the Extreme model.
